title: Tokens
description: data/tokens.json, and the workspace's tokens collection: every Token type keyed by its id. Loaded by src/config/registries/tokenRegistry.js; authored in cms/src/components/editors/TokenEditor.jsx and LifecycleBlocks.jsx. A Token's rules live in data/effects.json and it holds references (effects). Keys not listed here are reported as warnings (unknown keys), not errors.

weight.description: Relative weight of a weighted pick.

id.description: The Token's id, the same as its key (tokenRegistry.js). token_ followed by the slugged name while autoSyncId holds.

description.description: Derived by Recalculate from the Token's rules (cms/src/engine/descriptionDictionary.js), never typed. Display only.

sprite.description: A sprite id or path; missing falls back to the type id (tokenRegistry.js).

cardArt.description: The card's own backdrop picture (src/ui/components/board/tokenCard.js cardArtOf).

artSize.description: Only small counts, and only on a 1-by-1 Token (src/config/matGeometry.js).

tokenType.description: TOKEN_TYPES (src/config/registries/tokenConstants.js). Derived from the rules by Recalculate (writeBack.js deriveTokenType), never picked; read by targeting (filterRegistry.js), RecipeResolver.js and QuestManager.js.

rarity.description: TOKEN_RARITIES (tokenConstants.js). Only mythic matters in play: one placed at a time (src/systems/board/Placement.js).

tags.description: Mechanical, unlike item tags: a rule can aim at a tag, matched exactly and case-sensitively (filterRegistry.js).

tier.description: The default tier of its Acts-as tags and older provides (src/systems/effects/statements.js). The factory sets 1; no editor field.

uses.description: Charges it starts with (tokenRegistry.js tokenStartingUses): a whole number from 1, or null for unlimited, never 0 for unlimited.

requiresHero.description: false lets it work without a hero (BoardRunner.js, workSkillRule.js, Growth.js); absent means true.

noStackDuplicates.description: Its buffs do not stack with another copy (TileModifiers.js, supportLinks.js). No editor writes it.

clearable.description: true lets the player clear it (src/systems/board/Demolition.js).

landmark.description: An endgame site (tokenRegistry.js isLandmark): counts toward the Token cap and is never pushed.

autoSyncId.description: CMS only: true makes the id follow the name.

effects.description: Its rules, as references into data/effects.json (tokenRegistry.js expandBearer).

acceptedTokens.description: What must be nearby for it to work (src/systems/board/RecipeResolver.js checkAcceptedTokens): { tag, minTier } (minTier default 1) or { tokenIds } (any one of them). The CMS shows them as Requires rows.

config.description: Its work cycle, or null when it has no production side (src/systems/board/StationRecipe.js workConfigOf, WorkCheck.js, RecipeResolver.js).

skill.description: The skill that works it (src/config/registries/skillRegistry.js); empty or unknown means no hero can work it (the audit says so).

skillRequired.description: The level needed, a whole number from 1.

cycleTimeMs.description: Milliseconds a cycle; derived from Tempo by Recalculate. A recipe's durationMs wins.

xp.description: XP a cycle; derived by Recalculate unless sim.xpPinned.

needsTool.description: The tool a hero must hold (toolKinds.js neededToolOf; WorkCheck.js, Flags.js). Ignored when catchPools is present.

respawn.description: What happens when its charges run out (tokenConstants.js respawnOf; src/systems/board/Respawn.js).

mode.description: RESPAWN_MODES (tokenConstants.js): refill waits and refills; regrow turns into another Token.

into.description: regrow: the Token type it becomes; required, else the block is ignored.

needsNearby.description: refill: Token types that must be nearby.

spawner.description: It places other Tokens over time (src/systems/board/SpawnerSystem.js).

spawns.description: A weighted pick; at least one usable entry or it is inert.

allowance.description: How many it keeps out at once (a whole number).

upkeep.description: Paid per spawn, summed per item.

withinReach.description: true places spawns within its reach.

grows.description: It grows into another Token (src/systems/board/Growth.js, TimedChanges.js; tokenConstants.js growsTermsOf).

afterMs.description: Milliseconds to grow (the editor's minimum is 1000).

needsNearby.description: Token types that must be nearby.

turns.description: A chance each cycle to turn into another Token, and back (tokenConstants.js turnTiming; TimedChanges.js).

foundation.description: A building site: which building recipes it offers (recipePoolRegistry.js recipesForFoundation; StationRecipe.js, Foundations.js). Both kind and skill are needed.

tier.description: Its tier, against a recipe's foundationMinTier (tokenConstants.js foundationTierOf).

shop.description: It is sold in the shop (src/systems/board/Shop.js). The block counts only when price is a list.

section.description: A skill id or general; UI grouping only (MatCapBadge.jsx).

skills.description: Skill ids; unknown ones are dropped.

order.description: Its place in the list; missing sorts last.

group.description: Tokens with the same group label are one shop entry with options.

trickle.description: Passive Production lines paid once per shared lap (src/systems/board/PassiveProduction.js; PASSIVE_LAP_BASE_MS in tokenConstants.js).

everyMs.description: Ignored: every line is paid on the shared lap. No editor writes it.

catchPools.description: A water's catches by tool and bait (src/config/registries/catchPools.js catchPoolsOf; src/systems/board/Fishing.js). The first pool per tool and bait wins.

bait.description: An item id, or null for the basic pool.

field.description: A field that grows crops (tokenConstants.js fieldOf; src/systems/board/Fields.js). Blank strings are dropped.

startsWith.description: The id of a crop recipe it starts sown with.

camp.description: A camp that heroes of a skill work from (tokenConstants.js campOf; src/systems/board/Camps.js). No skill means not a camp.

reach.description: Not read: every camp works the one standard reach (reachRegistry.js STANDARD_REACH_U). Kept so older content still validates.

standsOn.description: STANDS_ON_CHOICES (src/systems/atlas/TerrainMap.js); empty means anywhere dry (tokenRegistry.js standsOnOf; SiteRules.js).

standsNear.description: Token types it must stand near (tokenRegistry.js; SiteRules.js).

enemy.description: It is an enemy: level makes it one (src/config/registries/enemyProfile.js). An authored number replaces what the level fills in.

resistances.description: By damage type or group; each value one of 100, 50, 25, -25, -50, others dropped (damageTypes.js normaliseResistances).

effectId.description: A library effect the move lands.

provides.description: Retired inline capability tags (strings or { tag, tier }), still read by statements.js and QuestManager.js; the CMS removes them when a rule is added.
